description:
Find Japanese grants and public support programs using official data published by government agencies.

Rather than simply listing programs, this app compares public company information with program requirements and clearly separates confirmed matches, possible mismatches, missing information, and official sources. This helps users understand why a program may be relevant and what still needs to be verified.

The app can be used by business owners and project leaders researching support for their own organizations, as well as by professional advisors researching programs for their clients or preparing for consultations.

When useful, it can also reference public corporate information and historical selection statistics, and organize unresolved questions into a consultation brief for a qualified professional.

Results are provided for research and decision support only. They do not guarantee eligibility, selection, funding amounts, or legal compliance. Before applying, always confirm the latest official guidelines and information published by the administering organization.

Primary official sources
- J-Grants
- gBizINFO
- National Tax Agency Corporate Number System
- Financial Services Agency EDINET

defaultPrompt: 自社の事業計画に合う補助金を探したいです。会社名や所在地、取り組み内容など、必要な情報を聞いたうえで、候補と確認すべき申請条件を比較してください。
検討中の補助金が自社に合うか確認したいです。事業との相性、申請資格、必要な自己資金や入金までの資金繰りを分けて整理し、不明な点は確認してください。
補助金の申請について専門家に相談したいです。これまでの検討内容と未確認事項を整理し、相談先、質問すること、準備する資料を相談メモにまとめてください。
